[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 120
- Description: Operational fixes + UX polish on the new QR-asset surfaces. Extended dao_client build_event_cli to auto-derive Attached Filename + Destination URL when --attachment is provided (mirrors dapp/report_contribution.html behaviour, fixes the silent fileUploadedToGithub:false failure mode hit earlier with the DeepSeek receipt). Re-submitted the .30 DeepSeek capital injection with the receipt PDF now committed to GitHub. Added URL query-param sync on Product Verification listing: search + asset-type + status filter changes update q=, type=, status= params via history.replaceState, page boots from URL on load, popstate handles browser back/forward — filtered views are now shareable + bookmarkable. Backfilled 1455 PNGs from the deprecated tokenomics/python_scripts/agroverse_qr_code_generator/package_qr_codes scratch dir into lineage-assets/pngs/, closing the gap from 729/1457 manifests-with-PNG to 1457/1457 (all manifests now resolve an image). Replaced the deprecated tokenomics batch_compiler.py with a fail-loudly stub that prints a migration message + sys.exit(2), so future operator muscle memory pointing at the old path gets corrected at first attempt instead of silently producing output in the wrong location. Styled all 6 distinct status values across the manifests (MINTED, SOLD, SAMPLE, ON CONSIGNMENT, EXPENSED, GIFT) on both the /qr/ page and the listing page; fixed the ON CONSIGNMENT class-name break (space was parsing as two HTML classes); listing-page stats cards now show every non-zero status dynamically instead of being hardcoded to MINTED/CONSIGNMENT/SOLD. Five PRs merged: dao_client 31, tokenomics 305, truesight_me_beta 135 and 136, plus direct push to lineage-assets. Production CNAME verified intact after each truesight prod sync via Contents API.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
--------
